reason: The free CA call before anything moves and the named AD Category-I bank on the receipt are what I'd want, since I'm scared of getting TDS or the 15CA/15CB wrong. Paying CAD $199 on about $15,900 is small next to the cost of a mistake, and nothing is charged until the money lands.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? The refund only returns their fee, not my time or the tax mess, and I haven't even logged into SBI in months.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual FINTRAC number and the partner bank's name before I commit, and a CA who will put in writing what my TDS and T1135 position is. If any of that looked vague I'd walk away.
